items.q: Which brands are available on MachineMaster?
items.a: MachineMaster can in principle be used for any brand, model or machine — even custom-built ones integrate without issue. The advantage of our brand-independent catalogue is that all machine data is entered and maintained by our team. Missing a brand? Our team will add it for you on request.

items.q: What happens when machine data changes?
items.a: Manufacturers constantly switch models or series — the MachineMaster team takes care of data upkeep. As soon as machine data changes, we correct and update it, so your website is always current.

items.q: How can used machines be uploaded to MachineMaster?
items.a: If you already have an account with the Technikbörse platform, you can connect it to MachineMaster — machines then appear automatically with all data. Alternatively, upload is possible via a simple input form.

items.q: Can the MachineMaster page be customized?
items.a: MachineMaster is offered as a white-label solution: layout and structure are predefined, but logo, font, color scheme and background image are yours to choose. You also set the title and metadata for your page yourself via your account.

items.q: How do I integrate the MachineMaster catalogue into my website?
items.a: Your personal machine catalogue, including configurator, is built and hosted by MachineMaster as a subdomain and integrates seamlessly into your existing website's menu. Our experts are happy to support you through the process.

items.q: What happens when a customer contacts you via MachineMaster?
items.a: The lead is forwarded directly to the designated contact person — definable individually per brand — with all details by email. Integration into your CRM system is possible on request.

items.q: What features is MachineMaster working on next?
items.a: Our team continuously improves the platform and incorporates current trends and innovations. Missing a feature? Feel free to contact us to discuss a custom offer.

sections.heading: Customer service rethought
sections.body: Almost all brands now offer the option of customizing their machines to the customer's wishes with numerous configuration options. However, this also poses problems - the large number of options often complicates the ordering process and causes confusion. The configurator from MachineMaster helps your customers to design the machine entirely according to their wishes.
features: All configuration options clearly displayed on one page
Predefined logic prevents conflicting configurations
Machine configuration without stress at home

sections.heading: Clear and uncomplicated
sections.body: Paper chaos? Still a common problem when it comes to machine configuration. Instead of having all the options clearly laid out on one page, many machine dealers still struggle through multi-page forms with explanations and notes. Not so with MachineMaster - here the customer can configure the machine at home and the desired configuration options are sent to the dealer as a well-organized e-mail.
features: Clear compilation of all options with explanations
The customer's chosen configuration is sent to the dealer by e-mail
Efficiently designed ordering process

sections.heading: Brand-independent

No more searching for the correct configurator
Same, easy operation for every brand

Organised retailer portfolio
No more switching between different websites

Quick and easy import instead of double work

retailerExchange.title: Retailer Exchange
retailerExchange.heading: The stock machine platform for the industry

sections.heading: Customer and retailer-oriented
sections.body: Is your warehouse full and yet the customer is looking for the exact machine that you don't have on site? A tricky situation: ordering from the manufacturer often takes a long time - in the worst case scenario, the customer cancels the order and buys the machine elsewhere. At the same time, stock levels are not reduced any further and the machines on site can lose their value due to long downtimes. The solution: Our dealer exchange offers the opportunity to contact other dealers with the right machine to avoid long waiting times for machines.
features: Optimized customer satisfaction due to shorter waiting times
Establishment of new business relationships
Reduction of stock levels through sales

sections.heading: Exchange at equal level
sections.body: The retailer exchange enables a fair sharing of information on both sides - so everyone involved benefits. To enable collaborative work at eye level, MachineMaster ensures that all participants only have access to the information they need for their own company.
features: Each participating retailer can only access stocks of their contracted brands
Access to the stocks of other dealers is only possible if they regularly upload their own machines
Contacts instead of prices - the focus is on availability & exchange

sections.heading: Simple to use
sections.body: A frequent point of anxiety when introducing new programs is the handling: can my employees use the program quickly and safely, or is regular training necessary? MachineMaster places particular focus on intuitive and simple operation that can be adopted by any employee.
features: Modern search function with all key data: brand, machine type, model, serial/internal no.
Straightforward contact with the right representative
Easy import of the machine inventory via CSV file/Excel table
Automatic deletion of all machines that no longer appear in a new import file
Access for several users per retailer possible
